title: Model Tension Orchestra and Procurement Scenarios
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Synthesize competitive signals into a decision-ready 'tension orchestra' matrix that maps model supply tension (availability, quantization compatibility, latency variance, pricing shock) against customer-facing constraints (SLO, regulatory region, data residency). Produce a short playbook with practical procurement triggers and 3 enterprise scenario runbooks (Graceful Degrade, Emergency Switch, Cost Shock) to hand off to Sales, SRE, and Solutions Engineering. Deliverables: tension matrix CSV, decision rules (if-then trigger list), three scenario runbooks, a lightweight dashboard spec for Console, and a telemetry/instrumentation checklist for SRE/Infra. This ticket covers the PM synthesis, field-recon hypothesis, and vendor-procurement threshold definitions. Engineering tasks and design mocks are tracked in sub-issues.
comments: 2025-02-10 — Kickoff: scoped outcomes with SRE (Nina), Solutions Eng (Jon), and Procurement (Liu). Agreed acceptance criteria: (a) matrix covers 6 supply signals, (b) each scenario includes stepwise playbook with SLAs and rollback criteria, (c) dashboard spec has two views: enterprise triage and week-over-week heatmap.

2025-02-11 — Rapid scan completed: collected 18 vendor telemetry points from model-watchtower and field probes. Early signal: two open models show frequent quant-compat regressions in apac-sg region under 8k token workloads.

2025-02-12 — Decision: use a 4-quadrant tension orchestra (Supply volatility vs Customer criticality) instead of the original 6-tier taxonomy to keep early adoption simple. Trade-off: loses some nuance for long-tail vendors but speeds adoption by Sales.
2025-02-13 — Feedback from Legal: procurement triggers must include an SLA delta and an explicit privacy checklist for Private deployments. Added to decision rules and scenario runbooks.

2025-02-14 — Engineering review (ENG-88222): agreed instrumentation hooks — model-availability webhook, rolling 95th latency per-region and per-quantization, and per-customer error-rate attribution key. Assigned ENG subtasks for telemetry. Link to ENG PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/1234

2025-02-15 — Design review: initial dashboard wireframes accepted with minor changes (add an 'affected customers' column, allow explode-to-customer timeline). Design mocks in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xExampleDesigns

2025-02-16 — Field validation plan approved: run the matrix against two active enterprise customers (Finance-Alpha, Retail-Delta) using synthetic workload probes over next 7 days. Solutions Eng to run canary probes and report anomalies to #pm-model-watch.
2025-02-17 — Blocker noted: procurement requires historical outage windows for vendor scoring. Action: Data team to supply rolling 90-day vendor availability export. Dependency added.
Next steps: finalize matrix CSV, publish playbook draft to Confluence, iterate dashboard spec with design, and confirm ENG instrumentation timeline (target ENG deploy by 2025-02-28).
